U_0x009436: A captured Lion, the <DC>'s mass-production <Armored Module>, with upgraded weapons/armor. Spare <Personal Trooper> parts from Huckebein, Gespenst and Alt Eisen are used - its arms are <Personal Trooper> parts, and folding leg blades give it close combat the Lion lacked. A stopgap between <Personal Trooper> and <Armored Module>, but high potential.
U_0x009718: Under Dr. Marion Radom's plan, Tasuku Shinguji upgraded the Guarlion Custom flown by his lover, Leona Garstein. Latest <Personal Trooper> tech and a <Tesla Drive> boost mobility/firepower, plus the <T-LINK System>. Like the Guarlion, shoulder inductors fix induction-heated metal particles ahead, wrapped and extended by a telekinetic field to strike foes.
U_0x009CE6: An <Armored Module> for space flight/vacuum work, from interstellar program <Project TD>. Newest Series 77 unit, based on the earlier Asterion AX. Twin flank <Tesla Drives> give unmatched mobility. Shifts between flight Cruise Figure (CF) and work Doll Figure (DF). Vs hostile deep-space life it mounts the gravity cannon 'G Accel Driver' and 'CTM' missiles.
U_0x00A05A: A high-mobility <Armored Module> from interstellar program <Project TD>. Newest of Series 77, based on the Calion. Two compact <Tesla Drives> give speed/agility beyond its sister, the Altairlion.
U_0x00A1F1: Combined form of the Altairlion and Vegalion, newest <Project TD> Series 77 units. Its mobility and agility top every <Armored Module>, with immense firepower.
U_0x00ACDE: A high-mobility <Armored Module> by <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>, designed from <Project TD> Calion/Vegalion data. Rivals the Vegalion; flexible wing weapon operators wield <Armored Module> and <Personal Trooper> firearms. Also has an MTD missile bay and a folding TDA nose.
U_0x00B141: An <Armored Module> based on a Galerion prototype, customized for the <Boosted Children>. Heavily armored, yet its <Tesla Drive> and thrusters outdo the Asterion AX.
U_0x00B2C3: An <Armored Module> based on a Galerion (Guarlion successor) prototype, tuned for the <Boosted Children>. Heavily armored, yet its <Tesla Drive> and back thrusters beat the Asterion AX in mobility. An EW model with EA (attack), EP (defense), ES (support) functions.
